notes.title: Demo Update – New Level + Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]We’ve rolled out a new update for the demo! This patch tackles a number of bugs and also introduces a brand-new fast-paced level. It’s completely optional, but we hope you’ll give it a try and have fun with it.[/p][h3]Highlights of this update:[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Level[/b]: [i]Intro City → Grass[/i] – a fast-paced experience added to the demo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Improvements[/b]: Adjusted interface on entry for a smoother start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Transitions[/b]: Cleaner fade-ins and improved loading flow.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Silver Nuggets[/b]: Now rewarded when re-doing an already completed cave puzzle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rail System Update[/b]: Adjustments made, though speed is still tied to FPS. If rails feel too fast, set your FPS to [i]Max 60[/i] in the settings menu and back out to apply.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Virtual Cameras[/b]: Now highlight which areas you’re moving into.[/p][/*][*][p][b]And More[/b]: Several smaller improvements under the hood, with plenty more on the way![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for checking out the demo and sharing your feedback—it really helps shape the game as we continue development![/p]
